# Review, pass 1 — secret-history-196-197 (§§196–197)

Reviewer: adversarial, pass 1 (units.json only; gloss.json not yet written). Inputs: conventions.md, runbook.md,
run3/RUNBOOK.md §2, packet.md, units.json, novel-forms.json, known-forms.json, the published glossary, the pilot.
`units.json` edited in place by script. After the edits: every unit's `t` is unchanged and still equals the packet's
romanized words for its run of indices (392 words, 48 units, indices 0–391 consumed once); every word still has
at least one morph; morph counts per word are unchanged; every morph gloss still ends in the packet's Ming gloss
for its word (0 mismatches). Units are numbered U0–U47 in order; word indices are the packet's.

Totals: 24 changes (2 major, 11 moderate, 11 minor); 12 findings refused.

## Findings refused

- U2 i “charging the messenger”: the bare imperative ügüle “say!” needs an addressee; the note already says it is supplied.
- U15 i “came over” for oroba: Ming 投入 “threw oneself in” supports joining; the note flags that the object is unstated.
- U12 i “drew his camp into a ring”: “camp” is not in küreġe; kept because the note says so and Ming 劄圈子 is a pitched circle, but it is a supplied noun, still uncertain.
- U26 i “thrown into confusion” for samaγ̇uraqu (of the daughter): intransitive in form, but the note flags the euphemism as unpinned; no better reading from the Ming 亂了.
- U23 Baγ̇aridai: the draft is right (Ming 種名 here, 人名/(兒)名 in the old glossary entry); not edited. Carry-forward for the glosser: broaden the entry with “also a people or clan, Ming 種名”.
- U29 i “Then” for tendēče (l “From there”): acceptable as a narrative “thereupon”; U28 keeps “From there”.
- U19 i “year of the Rat” against l “mouse” (known form “mouse”): the standard calendar name, said in the note.
- U35 “we should have gone … if we had met”: counterfactual perfect for conditional + ažuγ̇u “was”; plausible, and the note says -ju is uncertain.
- U3 i “has gone up” beside U4 “climbed”: within the speech a perfect for -ba is fine; kept.
- U10 i “until they were like rotten wood”: “like” supplied, but flagged uncertain in the note (Ming (爛木) in brackets).
- U4 “killed by the mouth” as “by words”, U5 imperative “take care” for qadaγ̇uči, U1 bölde “apart”: guesses, each already declared uncertain in the notes; l keeps the literal.
- čeri / čerig lemma for čeriġüd: the published glossary itself uses both (known-forms entries differ); left as čeri.

## Carry-forward for the glosser and pass 2

- Broaden: darulča- (known “follow close behind, Ming 緊隨”; here Ming 相壓着 “press upon one another”); Baγ̇aridai (above); ese-ü (-ü question, here no 麽); bolγan (add Ming 審, still “making”); öġere (add Ming 𠮠 already known).
- Novel stems whose lemma form depends on the glosser: id-, γulad-, bölde, qadaγ̇uči, ködölkün (-kün), büselgün, qunžiγ̇u, kemkerü, čeküi, žilda-type guesses. Keep every “uncertain” the notes carry.
- Pass 2 should check gloss.json entries for -(n)a, -(n)u, -ün, -žü, -ben, -dür, -tür against the corrected labels above.

## Findings refused / left as they are

- Known entries whose Ming differs only in spelling or a trailing particle from this part's use (γarba 上了 vs 上去了, abču 將着 vs 要着, qaγačan 離着 vs 分離, ede, sain 好的, niγur 面皮, ulus 國土, quluγana 鼠兒, ködölgežü 推動着 vs 敎動着, deġerēče 上處, tendēče 自那裏, Qadaγ-type name entries 種名 vs 一種姓氏, etc.): same word, same sense; not broadened (the entries are general to the form).
- ilerün idx 16 (Ming 去時): the known entry already carries "sending, when sending" and the 去 alternative; the note (pass 1 #16) records 去時. Left.
- gun (崖的 here, 山崖的 in the known entry) and qān (皇帝行 vs 皇帝): Ming variation only, left.
- bolγan broaden keeps "making" and records 審 as an unrendered nuance (matches the unit and pass 1 #2); left.
- Novel stems inferred from the Ming (id-, γulad-, üküdġü-, ürġü-, qutaγla-, buruγ̇uila-, esergüle-, güjiče-, žedgü-, tödeġe-, töridġe-, idγa-, öči-, sori-, tüši-, qurija-, kiliṅla- …) and the uncertain endings (-kün, -gün, -ju, -mu, -suγ̇asu): glossed as "inferred / uncertain" in both files; no invented modern form found; kept.
- kemkerü, baitala, bölde, qunžiγ̇u, čeküi, qadaγ̇uči, büselgün, ölgede: uncertain stems stated as uncertain in gloss and note; kept.
- gloss.json qaradal-hužaγ̇ur-a / küreġen-düri keys: odd-looking but they are the reader's tokens of t (build/validate confirm full coverage, no unused keys).
- Grammar names (converb, passive, causative, reciprocal, participle, hortative, optative, comitative, ablative, instrumental, reflexive-possessive) re-checked against the Ming and the glossary's usage for every entry: none misnamed.
- Names in i against the house lists (Qahan, Jamuqa, Tayang, Taichi'ud, Sa'ari-Keger, Kürbesü, Lady Qulan): consistent; Toqto'a-Beki, Küchülüg, Dair-Usun, Qo'as Merkid, Naya'a are first-time house forms here (no earlier part contradicts them).
- units.json p flags: § 196 (U0) and § 197 (U19) carry p: true; nothing to change.
